content:
Students, this one is for you. 💜

Job searching is already hard enough when you’re trying to build experience at the same time.

If you’re a current student and need help with your résumé, I’m offering a student discount through Purpose & Glow Career Solutions.

Whether you need your current résumé cleaned up or you’re starting from scratch, I can help make it more polished, ATS-friendly and targeted toward the kinds of roles you actually want.

I know students are usually working with tighter budgets, so I wanted to make this a little more affordable.

Student pricing:
Résumé revision: $65
Résumé from scratch: $95

Just send me a message and mention the student discount. 💜
comment: A strong résumé is only part of the equation. Students often need help translating projects, coursework, and part-time experience into measurable outcomes that employers can quickly understand.
